subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should WhatsApp inbound media abort after 30 seconds without a chunk, accepting that exceptionally slow transfers may fail so inbound dispatch cannot hang indefinitely?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the mechanism, but choosing the channel's fixed delivery cutoff is an operational tradeoff that requires WhatsApp-owner intent.

options.title: Accept the 30-second bound
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks, treating bounded dispatch and socket cleanup as more important than preserving indefinitely stalled or exceptionally slow transfers.

options.title: Tune the cutoff first
options.body: Choose a different owner-approved constant and rerun the same stalled, teardown, and progressing-stream proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks, treating bounded dispatch and socket cleanup as more important than preserving indefinitely stalled or exceptionally slow transfers.

likelyOwner.reason: The review timeline routes the WhatsApp-sensitive decision to this handle, and the prior review specifically called for WhatsApp-owner acceptance.
